title: Pip and Tumble's Five-Senses Thank-You
moral: Saying thank you makes everyone's heart feel warm.
description: Nana Hoot helps everybody in Clover Wood, so Pip and Tumble plan a secret thank-you surprise for all five of her senses! A giant sneeze, some very sour berries and one prickly pinecone later, will their surprise be ready? Learn to see, hear, smell, taste and touch in this funny animated story about gratitude for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Every single day, Nana Hoot helps EVERYBODY. She fixed Pip's kite. She knitted Tumble's cap. She even baked muffins for a sleepy snail!
But this morning, Nana's glasses slid down... down... DOWN her beak. And she said good morning to a big orange pumpkin!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Good morning, Pip dear! My, you look very round today!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Hee-hee! Nana, I'm over HERE!
Nana pushed up her glasses. Boing! Hoo-hoo-HOO! Everybody giggled.

narration.text: Pip and Tumble tiptoed away for a secret meeting. Shhh!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Nana always helps us. Let's say thank you!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Yes! A super-duper thank-you sur-PIE-prise!
A sur-pie-prise? Hee-hee! He means a SURPRISE, silly Pip!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Let's make a surprise for all FIVE of Nana's senses! Seeing, hearing, smelling, tasting and touching!

narration.text: First stop, Rainbow Meadow! Pip picked flowers for Nana to SEE. Red, yellow and purple! We see with our EYES.
Then Tumble gave a flower a great big sniff with his long trunk. Sniiiiiff...
AH... AH... AH-CHOOOO! WHOOSH! Petals flew everywhere!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Look at me! I'm a flower fox!

narration.text: Next stop, the berry bushes, for something yummy to TASTE!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I know! We taste with our... ELBOWS!
Elbows? Hee-hee! No way! What do YOU taste with?
Your TONGUE! Ding, ding! Well done!
Pip tasted one berry. SOUR! Scrunchy face! Another berry. SOUR! Super-scrunchy face! Then the third berry... Mmmm! Sweet!

narration.text: In Piney Woods, they looked for something soft to TOUCH. We touch and feel with our hands and paws!
Pip plopped down for a rest... right on a prickly pinecone! BOING! Up he jumped!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Yowie-zowie! That's not soft. That's PRICKLY!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Feel this moss, Pip. It's soft and squishy, like a cloud!
Soft moss for a comfy cushion. Four senses done. One to go!

narration.text: Last one! Something to HEAR. Up on Sunny Hill, they practised a thank-you song.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK-a-honk-HONK! Thank you, Naaaanaaaa!
Oopsie-trunk! The baby birds' feathers went all poofy! Too loud, Tumble! Hee-hee!
What do we use to HEAR a song?
Our EARS! Ding! So they sang it soft and sweet. La-la-laaa!

narration.text: At sunset, they tiptoed to Nana's tree. Nana was snoozing. Zzzz...

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo! I'm awake! I'm awake!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: SURPRISE, Nana! Thank you for always helping us!
Flowers to see and smell. Sweet berries to taste. A soft cushion to touch. And a song to hear!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! My heart feels so warm! Oh dear, there go my glasses again!

narration.text: Nana shared the berries with everyone. Let's remember! How many senses do we have? Count them on your fingers!
FIVE! See, hear, smell, taste and touch!
And what do we SEE with?
Our EYES! Hooray! You're a super-duper senses star!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: And saying thank you makes everybody feel super-duper good!
